summary: Register lists the Black Creek tower at Bruce Mines, Ontario as standing with its cab gone; no build, design, staffing or fire record found.

facts.status_note: The tower still stands, but its cab is gone.

evidence.supports: Register status: standing, cab gone; the only account of the tower today
evidence.quote: The tower is still standing, cab missing.

evidence.supports: Bruce Mines is on the north shore of Lake Huron in the Algoma District, along Highway 17
evidence.quote: located on the north shore of Lake Huron in the Algoma District along Highway 17

notes_for_editor: Only the register page and a town page support the story. One WebSearch, one websearch.py search, the SooToday fire-tower column and the Forest Rangers index found nothing on this tower by name. The brief's coordinates (46.82836, -83.28312) sit about 70 km northeast of Bruce Mines (Wikipedia gives 46.283, -83.783), so the coordinates and the place name disagree. Neither is corrected, because no source gives the tower's own location. The brief's access 'unknown' is not supported by any source and is left out. The story is about 60 words, under the 120-word guideline, because the sources give only location and status; it is not padded.
